bagPolicy.summary: Bags and backpacks no larger than 14 × 14 inches and small clutches are permitted; the club does not store prohibited items.
allowed: Bag or backpack up to 14 × 14 inches
prohibited: Bags or backpacks larger than 14 × 14 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
